description: This file defines a WebSocket connection manager class using FastAPI's WebSocket support. It manages active WebSocket connections, handles connection establishment and disconnection, broadcasting messages to connections related to specific events, and managing user-specific connections for real-time sports updates.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing WebSocket connections, including connecting, disconnecting, and broadcasting messages to clients based on event or user.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the connection manager with data structures for active connections, user connections, and connection metadata.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, event_id: str, user_id: str = None)
methods.description: Handles a new WebSocket connection, stores connection details, and sends a welcome message.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from all tracking structures.

methods.name: send_personal_message(self, message: Dict[str, Any], websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific WebSocket client.

methods.name: broadcast_to_event(self, message: Dict[str, Any], event_id: str)
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSocket clients connected to a specific event.

methods.name: broadcast_emoji_reaction(self, event_id: str, emoji_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts an emoji reaction update to all clients connected to an event.

methods.name: broadcast_match_update(self, event_id: str, match_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts a match data update to all event-connected clients.

methods.name: send_to_user(self, user_id: str, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a message directly to a specific user identified by user ID.

methods.name: int get_connection_count(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the number of active connections for a specific event.

methods.name: int get_total_connections(self)
methods.description: Returns the total number of active WebSocket connections.

methods.name: List[str] get_active_events(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of event IDs currently with active connections.
